title: %reduce — fold an array with a verb
purpose: Combine all elements into one value using a named verb and a seed.
notes: The verb name is a quoted string; it is applied as verb(accumulator, element).
The third argument is the initial accumulator and the result for an empty array.

avoid.why: the fold verb must be a quoted name ("add"), not a nested %add call; the %add form is parsed as its own verb and raises an arity error
